acceptance: Either ty resolves the namespace without a wrapper (for example via configuration) or the wrapper becomes the single type-check command.
The two CI guards collapse to one; the pinned boundary and parity tests are updated in the same change.
Editor diagnostics for benchbox._vendor.sqlglot are not noisy.
description: ty reports about 680 warnings (unresolved-import, possibly-missing-attribute) for benchbox._vendor.sqlglot because the runtime is a zip archive. A wheel-aware wrapper (scripts/typecheck.py, make typecheck) extracts typing data to a temp directory, and CI now runs both it and the plain 'uv run ty check'. The plain command and its pinned test (test_ci_lint_environment_boundary) still see unresolved imports, and editors and LSPs do too.
